timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Let's learn a little bit more about you beyond your senator's role. What was your first job?
Kentucky Fried Chicken. So fast food job. What was your favorite teacher or class in high school?
I particularly liked math and I had a geometry teacher, Mr. Loeker, who was very influential.
In my senior year, I took a class on political science. Partly that class made me
think about the potential of maybe someday serving in elective office. What's a favorite comfort food
or guilty pleasure when the calories don't count? I would say cheese, although I would say that's not
just a comfort food. I enjoy cheese all the time, but there are certain things like cheese curds
that I just love. Great E or deep fried. Squeaky. How many of your friends, neighbors and colleagues
regularly jump into a lake that's still got ice on it? None.

youtube_description:
Remember that time when new US Senate candidate Eric Hovde jumped into an icy lake to try to prove his Wisconsin roots? We asked Sen. Tammy Baldwin about that during a recent one-on-one interview—which also included a few quick questions about her favorite things.
